what: PU Verificado, phase A: every Tesouro Direto LTN and NTN-F price in the pinned history decided from the STN/ANBIMA rule table in exact arithmetic, both sides, under the pre-registered settlement hypotheses and printed readings. Generated by tools/run-pu-ledger.js; the Python decider cross-checks the sample recorded below.

lft.projection: VNA(quote) × (1 + meta)^(trunc14(k/252)) at full precision, truncated at 6; the accumulated factor A-16 at each step

hypotheses.D1x: next business day skipping 24 and 31 December (amendment 1, 2026-10-16)
hypotheses.pre: the calendar as of the quotation: no 20 November holiday from 2024 on (amendment 2, 2026-10-16)
hypotheses.b3: settlement on the next day B3 traded (corpus/pu/b3-settlement.json; phase B, B1); /r marks a path through a rule-only day

consistent.definition: not REPRODUCED under any hypothesis; the printed centavos lie within [trunc2(PU(rate − ½ unit)), round2(PU(rate + ½ unit))] under the primary hypothesis — the printed rate is a rounding of the one used

codes.x: REPRODUCED only under D+1x (24/31 December skipped)
codes.k: REPRODUCED only under the calendar as of the quotation (no 20 November holiday after 2023)
codes.b: REPRODUCED only with settlement on B3's calendar (a São Paulo holiday or 24/31 December skipped; /r when the skipped day is rule-only)
codes.c: CONSISTENT: inside the price interval the printed rate's precision allows, not reproduced exactly

atlas.side: compra, settlement D+1 (D+1x where it differs)
